ops.body: Widening-addendum refuter pass on bba8159c (separate from round 3): the CostError→AccountingIntegrityError widening is sound and correctly routed live (no demotion path to infra/candidate anywhere). Three findings, all routed into A3.5: HIGH — resume re-bills an aborted unit at full cap (spent reconstructed from journal+sidecar misses the unknown spend; repeated restarts re-bill unboundedly) — already closed by M1's resume-refusal; the repeated-restart scenario added as an explicit required test. MED → M2: CLI version-skew DoS — claude CLI v1.0.21 emitted total_cost (renamed total_cost_usd in v1.0.22 per Anthropic's changelog), so a healthy old CLI now hard-aborts every successful proposal; fix = version-floor check in the A2 research preflight (PreflightFailure before any spend, named constant with changelog cite), NOT legacy-field parsing. MED → M3: accounting aborts invisible in MorningReport (units=0/crashes=0 — indistinguishable from a quiet run); report derives accounting_aborts from the M1 sidecar marker, rendered by nightly. A3.5 final scope: H1 earliest-point validation, H2 full inversion (both recovered_cost callers per the recorded policy decision), M1 + restart test, M2, M3.
